insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Heavenly Bodies generated $8,485 in total sales in Week 46 on 150 units, led by the Tarot Deluxe Boxset at $6,930, which improved its conversion to 6.3% (+14.9%). The Tarot 3-pack grew to $351 (+200.0%) with conversion at 8.3%, the Tarot & Astrology 2-pack held steady at $574 (+0.0%) with conversion up to 9.2%, and Monday, Nov 9 was the peak day at $1,589.

**Metrics to Watch —** Total sales eased 16.3% from $10,141 the prior week, mainly because Tarot Boxset sessions fell 28.3% to 1986, taking that SKU to $6,930 (-17.6%). The Astrology Boxset dipped to $630 (-39.1%) as conversion slipped to 3.0%, and PPC revenue eased to $1,916 (-15.1%). The silver lining: Tarot Boxset conversion improved 14.9% to 6.3%, and organic sales of $6,569 still carried the week. Our focus is rebuilding traffic to both decks so the stronger Tarot conversion turns into more sales.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS stayed lean at 8.8% (prior 5.99%), and ad spend of $749 generated $1,916 in PPC revenue for a 2.56x ROAS (prior 3.71x) at a 39.1% ACOS. With spend up to $749 from $607, ad CTR at 0.37% and ad conversion at 2.84% of clicks, tightening targeting toward high-intent tarot and astrology gift searches is the clearest path back toward last week's 3.71x ROAS.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Shift budget toward the best-converting Tarot Boxset keywords and add negatives on non-converting clicks to lift ad conversion above 2.84%. (2) Build gift-focused campaigns for the bundle packs, following the Tarot 3-pack's +200.0% week and the 2-pack's 9.2% conversion. (3) Test new Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift the 0.37% ad CTR and rebuild Tarot Boxset traffic from 1986 sessions as we head into the holiday season.
